name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid Turbo v3 (int8, 8 steps)
author: Darksidewalker
note: The hybrid with his latest distillation blend built in: 8 steps with euler and the simple scheduler, no turbo LoRA on top, about twice as fast, with the loss of detail any turbo has (his words: turbo is always a quality loss for H3 at the moment). His settings, set here: shift 8 for the video (he gives 6 to 12) and 4 for the sound (3 to 5). Rechecked against his page on 5 October 2026: v3 is his newest.
